# MaxMind database fixtures

`GeoIP2-City-Test.mmdb` and `GeoLite2-ASN-Test.mmdb` are synthetic records from the [MaxMind-DB test data](https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB/tree/c454a21f31fd17f2843f16094e9afb3a14a42078/test-data), distributed under the included MIT license. They support offline tests and contain no production peer data.
